text:
Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted. With an explicit type, it remained `None`, so invoking the flag stored `None` instead of the flag’s enabled value.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer `flag_value` for all flag options, while still inferring the type only when no explicit type is provided. Explicit types now convert the flag value as expected.

`tests/test_options.py`: 133 passed.

--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -2611,12 +2611,14 @@ class Option(Parameter):
                 self.default = False
 
         self.type: types.ParamType
-        if is_flag and type is None:
+        if is_flag:
             if flag_value is None:
                 flag_value = not self.default
-            # Re-guess the type from the flag value instead of the
-            # default.
-            self.type = types.convert_type(None, flag_value)

final_text:
Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted. With an explicit type, it remained `None`, so invoking the flag stored `None` instead of the flag’s enabled value.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer `flag_value` for all flag options, while still inferring the type only when no explicit type is provided. Explicit types now convert the flag value as expected.

`tests/test_options.py`: 133 passed.
